cases.name: offline_queue_drain
cases.detail: accumulated offline then drained on reconnect: the dose was answered with no default network, queued (queue_pending=3) and verifiably absent from Convex; after the network returned it arrived in 0s (4s from the airplane-mode toggle, budget 60s) and the queue drained to 0. Verified server-side by localId bb0e588a-d11b-4b8c-9c99-de7000663f58, not from the app's own sync_status. queue_dead=0
